input.summary: Insert numbered Subparagraph 18.8 giving Teleglobe USA Inc. (the Customer) a 30-day convenience exit with pro-rata refund of prepaid amounts.
input.comment: [Playbook] We added Subparagraph 18.8 giving us, as Customer, a convenience exit on thirty (30) days' prior written notice with a pro-rata refund of amounts we have prepaid, since Paragraph 18 otherwise locks us in for the full twenty-five year Initial Period. The right is ours alone, so the other Parties still cannot walk away mid-term.

ops.text: 18.8 In addition to Subparagraph 18.1, Teleglobe USA Inc. (the "Customer") may terminate its participation in this Agreement for convenience at any time by giving not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice to the other Parties, and the other Parties shall refund to the Customer, pro rata, any amounts prepaid by it for the period after the effective date of such termination.
